title: SPARCL: Spatially Adaptive Regional Coverage for Active Learning in Chest X-ray Analysis
title_zh: SPARCL：胸部X光分析中主动学习的空间自适应区域覆盖方法

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种新的主动学习方法SPARCL，用于胸部X光病变分割，该方法能够动态平衡预测不确定性与累积空间覆盖度。 Pixel-level annotation for chest X-ray (CXR) lesion segmentation is expensive, making active learning (AL) essential. However, existing AL strategies fail to account for the spatial distribution of selected samples, resulting in inconsistent performance across focal (e.g., aortic calcification) and diffuse (e.g., nodules) pathologies. In this paper, we propose SPARCL (Spatially Adaptive Regional Coverage for Active Learning) to dynamically balance predictive uncertainty with cumulative spatial coverage. By employing a concave coverage function, SPARCL imposes diminishing returns on previously annotated regions, naturally directing the annotation budget toward under-labeled areas. Furthermore, an entropy gate reverts the algorithm to standard uncertainty sampling when spatial variation is absent. This coverage objective is monotone submodular, guaranteeing near-optimal greedy batch selection. To address how aggregate metrics like Dice obscure regional failures, we further introduce two metrics---Spatial Inconsistency (SI) and Performance Coverage (PC)---to quantify anatomical fairness across AL rounds. Evaluated on an in-house calcification cohort and public CXR benchmarks, SPARCL reaches 95% of fully supervised performance using only 24% of the data, compared to 29% for the best baseline. Ultimately, SPARCL ensures robust spatial reliability, surfacing regional gains that aggregate metrics miss.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种新的主动学习方法SPARCL，用于胸部X光病变分割，该方法能够动态平衡预测不确定性与累积空间覆盖度。胸部X光（CXR）病变分割的像素级标注成本高昂，因此主动学习（AL）至关重要。 然而，现有的主动学习策略未能考虑所选样本的空间分布，导致在局灶性病变（例如主动脉钙化）和弥漫性病变（例如结节）上的表现不一致。 在本文中，我们提出了SPARCL（空间自适应区域覆盖主动学习），以动态平衡预测不确定性与累积空间覆盖度。 通过采用凹型覆盖函数，SPARCL对已标注区域施加递减的回报效应，从而自然地将标注预算引导至标注不足的区域。 此外，当不存在空间变化时，一个熵门会将算法回退到标准的采样不确定性方法。 这一覆盖目标是单调子模的，因此能够保证贪心批量选择接近最优解。 为了解决Dice等聚合指标如何掩盖区域失败的问题，我们进一步引入了两种指标——空间不一致性（SI）和性能覆盖度（PC），以量化主动学习各轮次中的解剖学公平性。 在内部钙化数据集和公开的CXR基准数据集上进行评估后，SPARCL仅使用24%的数据便达到了完全监督方法95%的性能，而最佳基线方法则需要29%的数据。 最终，SPARCL确保了稳健的空间可靠性，并揭示了聚合指标所忽略的区域性改进。
